articles.title: MacSync’s New Infection Chain Shows How Mac Malware Is Becoming More Sophisticated
articles.summary:
A newly observed MacSync campaign shows a marked evolution in macOS-focused crimeware, replacing relatively simple AppleScript-driven delivery with layered binary loaders, encrypted modules, cloud-hosted staging, and a persistent backdoor. articles.title: Citrix Confirms NetScaler Zero-Day RCE Flaws Actively Exploited in Attacks
articles.summary:
Citrix has released emergency security updates for NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway after confirming active exploitation of two critical zero-day vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772. Both bugs have a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.5 and can enable remote code execution (RCE) against vulnerable customer-managed appliances. The flaws are part of a wider set of eight vulnerabilities […]
